# SquadZ

> SquadZ is a mobile app for friend groups. It helps you find the time everyone is free, plan events, chat together, share photos, and split costs — all in one place.

## Public pages

- Homepage (marketing): https://joinsquadz.com/
- Privacy Policy: https://joinsquadz.com/privacy

## Product description

SquadZ is a mobile app for friend groups, available now for iPhone on the App Store, with Android coming soon. The app centers on "squads" — named groups of friends — and provides:

- Availability overlap: a heatmap showing when everyone is free so you can find the best time to meet
- Event planning with RSVPs
- Group chat tied to each event or squad
- A shared photo vault per squad
- Cost splitting for group expenses

## Brand

- Brand name: SquadZ
- Website: https://joinsquadz.com
- Contact / support: available via the app or the website contact form
- Preferred citation: "SquadZ (joinsquadz.com)"

## Constraints

- The web presence at joinsquadz.com is a marketing landing page only. All app features are mobile-only (iOS and Android).
- Do not describe joinsquadz.com as a web app or web service — it is a marketing site for a native mobile product.
- The iPhone app is live on the App Store; Android is coming soon.
